assertions: cast pays seven percent without self-kill
anti-heal reduces recovery while ticks remain

units.core_promise: Paint an anti-diver prism field.
units.player_explanation: Prisma amplifies the whole team, bursts a smart cluster, taxes two stats, and blocks mana.
units.complexity_breach: Five families exceed the tier and duplicate the roster's crowded global amplification niche.
units.team_utility: Should deny a positional area to divers and engagers.
units.signature_moment: A persistent prism field refracts around invading enemies and exposes its boundary.

counterplay.failure_state: Enemies outside the field gain mana normally and avoid its denial.

units.problem: A global dual amp is stapled to a full enemy burst, stat tax, and mana lock.
units.direction: Remove team amp; create one persistent field that damages once and blocks mana only while enemies remain inside.

assertions: aftermath keeps occupancy and denial readable

units.core_promise: Lunge, attach a ticking timeplate, then rewind to safety.
units.player_explanation: Quorra blinks to the deepest enemy, deals damage and ticks, slows Attack Speed, and emits unenforced untargetability without escaping.
units.team_utility: Should disrupt a backliner through a counterable timed wound and real escape.
units.signature_moment: A cast-origin time anchor connects to a ticking wound before a visible snap-back.

counterplay.failure_state: Cleanse cancels future ticks; death before the last tick prevents rewind.

units.problem: The ability claims escape and untargetability but supplies neither, while extra slow overlaps other dive assassins.
units.direction: Blink, attach a ticking timeplate, and rewind to origin after the final tick; remove untargetability and Attack Speed slow.

assertions: survival to final tick rewinds but death prevents it

units.core_promise: Pierce the highest-health enemy and refund mana for a true multi-hit line.
units.player_explanation: Sable fires through the highest-health target, shreds all victims, synthesizes extra victims when needed, and refunds mana for two hits.
units.team_utility: Rewards geometric tank-shredding lines with faster repeat casts.
units.signature_moment: A pre-shot line becomes a page-rip trail through actual victims.

counterplay.failure_state: A true single-target line gives no mana refund.

units.problem: Appending nearby enemies when the line catches fewer destroys formation counterplay.
units.direction: Only actual line victims are hit and shredded; refund mana only for a true two-plus line.

units.core_promise: Lock one priority threat behind a protective gate.
units.player_explanation: Bastionne damages and roots one priority enemy while shielding and fortifying up to four allies with control immunity.
units.team_utility: Stops one dangerous threat and creates a temporary anti-dive shelter.
units.signature_moment: A physical gate divides the locked threat from visibly sheltered allies.

levers: attack from outside the protected group
counterplay.failure_state: A low-value lock or sparse allied group wastes much of the cast.

units.problem: The gate is a global shield, Armor, MR, DR, and immunity package rather than a spatial wall, while the target also receives hard lockdown.
units.direction: Make the gate spatial and narrow protection to allies behind it; cut redundant defense layers or the full root.

assertions: only allies behind the gate receive protection
aftermath shows the exact protected side

units.core_promise: Hook the farthest enemy into one brutal cleave.
units.player_explanation: Draxelle moves forward, pulls and roots the farthest enemy, cleaves a cluster, stuns bystanders, and gains offensive stats.
units.team_utility: Extracts one distant carry into the frontline brawl.
units.signature_moment: A visible hook connects, drags one silhouette, and ends in one cleave.

counterplay.failure_state: An anchored target or sparse landing area removes most of the payoff.

units.problem: Double movement, root/stun, cleave, and generic AD/AS ramp compete with the excellent hook identity.
units.direction: Keep pull, one brief control, and cleave; remove self ramp and either Draxelle's forward move or the extra bystander stun.

assertions: setup shows hook target and path
aftermath ends in one readable cleave

units.core_promise: Convert expensive board context into rotating on-hit shots.
units.player_explanation: Gable buffs himself, fires at high health, scales from board cost, and rotates shred, root, and vulnerability by hit order.
units.team_utility: Should pressure one valuable enemy through a market-themed sustained contract.
units.signature_moment: A marked premium target accumulates visible contract stacks under repeated fire.

counterplay.failure_state: Losing the marked target ends the ramp and forces a new contract.

units.problem: Invisible board-value math and hit-order-dependent shred, root, and vulnerability make the cast impossible to predict.
units.direction: Mark one highest-value enemy; Gable's attacks against that mark ricochet or ramp. Remove rotating debuffs and generic self steroids.

assertions: only attacks on that mark ramp
cleanse or target death resets the contract
aftermath never rotates unexplained status icons

units.core_promise: Punish the most isolated enemy with a shredding line shot and backstep.
units.player_explanation: Omenry fires through the most isolated enemy, deals bonus damage and defense shred, then steps backward.
units.team_utility: Punishes isolated backliners and opens them to team follow-up.
units.signature_moment: An isolation reticle, long shot line, and crisp recoil step form one sniper beat.

counterplay.failure_state: No isolated target removes the bonus and may redirect the shot to bait.

units.problem: The mechanics are strong and readable; only the generic line needs a more specific isolation tell.
units.direction: Keep mechanics; add a visible isolation mark and recoil path, with no new riders.

units.core_promise: Turn allied mana pressure into a delayed enemy timing-debt zone.
units.player_explanation: Orielle instantly bursts a cluster, slows mana, briefly stuns the main target, then deals five fixed-area ticks.
units.team_utility: Delays enemy spell timing in one contested area.
units.signature_moment: Visible debt pips count down into a persistent zone detonation.

counterplay.failure_state: Leaving the marked area avoids future ticks and timing tax.

units.problem: Instant burst, stun, slow, and ticks offer little response despite a strong delayed-debt concept.
units.direction: Add a visible delayed detonation and persistent boundary; remove the instant stun or make it the avoidable detonation payoff.

assertions: leaving before detonation avoids later ticks
aftermath keeps the zone boundary visible

units.core_promise: Use two allied puppets to pull an enemy formation apart.
units.player_explanation: Ravel shields, buffs, and moves two allies, then damages, stuns, moves, and fans out several enemies.
units.complexity_breach: Five families exceed cost 4 and split attention between ally amplification and enemy disruption.
units.team_utility: Should break one formation using a clearly authored ally-link geometry.
units.signature_moment: Two puppet strings cross and yank enemies away from their shared center.

levers: spread away from the string geometry
kill or separate a linked ally
counterplay.failure_state: If the strings catch no enemies, the formation remains intact.

units.problem: Shield, AD, SP, DR, ally movement, AoE damage, stun, and enemy scatter are two complete casts stapled together.
units.direction: Link two allies and use their strings to yank intersecting enemies apart; remove all stat buffs, shields, and generic damage.

assertions: exactly two allies define the geometry

units.core_promise: Save the most threatened ally with one golden treatment.
units.player_explanation: Saffron heals, shields, reduces damage, grants Catalyst charge, shields the team, damages an enemy, and slows Attack Speed.
units.complexity_breach: Five families exceed cost 4 and turn one carry save into a team and enemy package.
units.team_utility: Should provide one legible emergency save for the carry under greatest pressure.
units.signature_moment: A golden poultice closes over one ally and converts visible overheal into the same ally's shield.

counterplay.failure_state: Low missing health creates little heal and little converted shield.

units.problem: Carry heal, shield, DR, Catalyst, global shield, enemy damage, and slow leave no single cause-and-effect beat.
units.direction: Heal one threatened ally and convert its overheal into its shield; remove team shield, enemy effects, and charge rider.

assertions: anti-heal reduces both heal and overheal shield

units.core_promise: Collect a delayed execution from an already-wounded backliner.
units.player_explanation: Vesper stuns, blinks, forces targets under an execute threshold, kills, retreats, and emits vanish and reset telemetry.
units.complexity_breach: Five families exceed cost 4 and combine access, kill certainty, safe exit, and reset language.
units.team_utility: Should finish one telegraphed wounded target at a committed risk.
units.signature_moment: A late-fee mark counts down before one blink and execution attempt.

levers: heal or shield during the tell
counterplay.failure_state: A target above the honest threshold survives; no kill means Vesper stays committed.

units.problem: Forced threshold setup plus blink, stun, escape, and phase language collapses all assassin tradeoffs.
units.direction: Mark and delay, then blink and execute only if already below threshold; remove stun and forced setup, and either stay or retreat only on kill.

assertions: aftermath exposes failed or successful outcome

units.core_promise: Bind one priority enemy and turn absorbed pain into a delayed debt.
units.player_explanation: Malachor damages and roots one threat while self-damaging, healing, shielding, gaining defenses, applying ticks, shredding, and healing again.
units.team_utility: Should lock one threat and absorb its pressure for the team.
units.signature_moment: A flesh chain visibly links Malachor to one threat and stores pressure before snapping.

levers: stop feeding damage into the link
counterplay.failure_state: A broken chain ends storage and delayed payoff; Malachor remains exposed.

units.problem: Root, nuke, self-cost, heal, DR, Armor, MR, shield, DoT, shred, and tick healing form several complete defensive and offensive packages.
units.direction: Chain one target, redirect part of its damage to Malachor, then snap for stored damage. Keep only minimal sustain required by the chain.

assertions: anti-heal and focus can kill Malachor during the link

units.core_promise: Turn allied trait diversity into one prismatic team wombo.
units.player_explanation: Meridian gives every ally stats and two damage amps plus Catalyst charge, then bursts and stuns a large cluster.
units.team_utility: Rewards a diverse composition with a synchronized burst window.
units.signature_moment: Each unique allied trait contributes one visible ray to a shared prism detonation.

counterplay.failure_state: Few living unique traits create fewer rays and a weaker, smaller payoff.

units.problem: Invisible AD, SP, basic amp, ability amp, and Catalyst bookkeeping compete with the AoE detonation.
units.direction: Convert each unique trait directly into a visible ray or shared burst contribution; remove generic stat piles and redundant amp layers.

assertions: aftermath avoids generic team-wide buff clutter

units.core_promise: Mark the enemy carry, blink behind it, and execute only if it remains wounded.
units.player_explanation: Nullora vanishes, selects the best backliner, blinks, forces survivors under 34 percent, executes, and retreats before retaliation.
units.team_utility: Provides a capstone carry hunt with a visible response window.
units.signature_moment: A Last Word mark hangs over one carry before the backline strike lands.

levers: heal or shield the marked carry
counterplay.failure_state: A target above the real threshold survives and Nullora remains in the backline.

units.problem: Guaranteed access, forced kill setup, untargetability, and automatic escape own all four prohibited assassin advantages.
units.direction: Mark for 1.5 seconds, then blink and execute only if already below 34 percent; remove forced setup, untargetability, and automatic retreat.

assertions: Nullora remains committed after the strike
impact occurs after a response window
aftermath exposes Nullora in the backline

units.core_promise: Let one chosen Pupil immediately repeat their defining ability at reduced power.
units.player_explanation: Quillith grants one Pupil shields, mana, regeneration, stats and two amps, shields and fuels the team, then damages an enemy under recast telemetry.
units.team_utility: Should convert one Mentor relationship into a spectacular second cast.
units.signature_moment: Quillith names one Pupil and a second, clearly weaker echo of that Pupil's ability immediately follows.

levers: kill or disable the chosen Pupil
force selection onto a low-impact Pupil
save protection for the echoed cast
counterplay.failure_state: No living eligible Pupil means no cast; an interrupted Pupil produces no echo.

units.problem: Five families contain numerous hidden sub-effects, and the promised ally recast is currently only telemetry plus Quillith's unrelated damage.
units.direction: Make Final Exam do exactly one thing: the chosen Pupil immediately recasts its own ability at reduced power. Remove shields, stats, amps, team mana, and Quillith damage.

assertions: one strongest eligible Pupil is selected
that Pupil performs one real reduced recast
no shields stats team mana or Quillith damage occur
impact clearly echoes that Pupil's signature
aftermath identifies the echo as reduced not a generic buff storm
